## Summary

I escalated ticket T-5005 to a human engineer. The Prometheus pod in the monitoring namespace is running and marked as ready with zero restarts, but the ticket reports data gaps in all Grafana dashboards since around 03:00 and missed alerts overnight. This indicates a data collection issue rather than a pod availability issue. Since this affects the observability infrastructure itself and involves potential data loss, it requires a human engineer to safely investigate the Prometheus configuration, scrape target status, and storage integrity without risking further loss of diagnostic visibility.
